items.name: O-25 Oxygen recycler
items.description: Equip in a special slot to reduce suit oxygen consumption by 25%. Requires a life-support collar. Multiple recyclers do not stack.
items.descriptionZh: 装入特殊装备槽后，氧气消耗降低 25%。需要装备生命维持项圈。多个循环器不叠加。

items.name: G-60 Glare filter
items.description: Equip in a special slot to reduce aimed-light glare and flash grenade exposure by 60%. Multiple filters do not stack.
items.descriptionZh: 装入特殊装备槽后，瞄准强光和闪光弹造成的眩目强度降低 60%。多个滤镜不叠加。

items.name: SR-500 Survey instrument
items.description: Combines compass bearings and 500-metre laser ranging in one special slot. Measures the first solid surface; cannot see through walls.
items.descriptionZh: 装入特殊装备槽后，同时显示罗盘方位和最远 500 米的测距。测量视线中的第一个实体表面，不透墙。

items.name: Hemostatic bandage
items.description: Apply for 1.5 seconds to stop bleeding and restore up to 15 HP to one body part. Use from pockets or an equipped badge.
items.descriptionZh: 使用 1.5 秒后止血，并为一个身体部位恢复最多 15 点生命。须放在衣兜或已装备的胸章中。

items.name: Rescue medical kit
items.description: Treat one body part for 5 seconds to restore up to 100 HP. Use from an equipped badge. Does not raise the recoverable health limit.
items.descriptionZh: 治疗一个身体部位 5 秒，恢复最多 100 点生命。须放在已装备的胸章中。不提高生命恢复上限。

items.name: Hydration gel
items.description: Consume in 1.5 seconds for 10 energy and 25 hydration. Occupies 10 fullness.
items.descriptionZh: 食用 1.5 秒，补充 10 点能量和 25 点水分，增加 10 点饱腹度。

items.name: Compressed expedition ration
items.description: Eat for 5 seconds for 75 energy and 50 fullness. Consumes 15 hydration.
items.descriptionZh: 食用 5 秒，补充 75 点能量，增加 50 点饱腹度，消耗 15 点水分。

items.name: O-20 Rapid oxygen flask
items.description: Refill 20 oxygen in 1 second. Use from pockets or an equipped badge with a life-support collar. Excess oxygen is lost.
items.descriptionZh: 使用 1 秒补充 20 点氧气。需要生命维持项圈，须放在衣兜或已装备的胸章中。超出的氧气不保留。

items.name: Flash grenade
items.description: 2-second fuse. Dazzles exposed targets within 12 metres for up to 4 seconds. Looking away, cover and smoke reduce or block exposure. Can dazzle the thrower.
items.descriptionZh: 引信 2 秒。使 12 米内暴露的目标眩目，最长 4 秒。背向、掩体和烟雾可减轻或阻挡效果，也会影响投掷者。

items.name: Poison gas bomb
items.description: 3-second fuse. Creates a 3-metre poison cloud for 15 seconds. Poison deals damage and prevents healing. Antidote protects; choke clouds disperse it.
items.descriptionZh: 引信 3 秒。产生半径 3 米、持续 15 秒的毒雾。中毒持续受伤且无法治疗。解毒针提供保护，驱散弹可清除毒雾。

items.name: Regeneration shot
items.description: Inject for 3 seconds to restore 2 total HP per second for 120 seconds. Prioritizes injured surviving parts. Poison pauses healing; destroyed parts and lost health limits stay unchanged. Reuse refreshes duration without stacking.
items.descriptionZh: 注射 3 秒后，持续 120 秒，每秒全身合计回复 2 点生命，优先恢复受伤的存活部位。中毒时暂停回血，不恢复损毁部位和已损失的生命上限。重复注射只刷新时长。
